Summarize methodology, business rules, assumptions, decisions, transformation logic, AI prompts, AI training, and AI tools used.
Explain where human-in-the-loop SME input and data governance are required for areas that cannot be standardized or normalized.
Explain how the approach scales from 10 hospitals to approximately 200 hospitals for enterprise deployment.
Produce SV-2 Systems Resource Flow Description reflecting the EHR to EIMS to FMS workflow and cleaned dataset.
Produce DIV-1 Conceptual Data Model reflecting the workflow and cleaned dataset.
Produce DIV-2 Logical Data Model reflecting the workflow and cleaned dataset.
Deliver a live, non-pre-recorded virtual demonstration not exceeding 30 minutes.
Prepare for a Government Q&A period limited to 15 minutes with two posed questions.
